$comment: Structured risk tier per skill (trust idea #3). Resolution: skill override > highest tier of any bundle the skill belongs to > default. Tiers drive disclaimers, the human-review requirement (config/human-review.json), and UI labelling. Bundles/skills listed here must exist; scripts/check-risk-tiers.mjs validates that and emits data/risk-tiers.json.

tiers.high-stakes: Being wrong can cost money, rights, health, or safety. Requires a not-advice boundary, routes to a professional, and a current human review.
tiers.consequential: Affects a job, a relationship, or a material decision. Requires a clear not-advice boundary where relevant.
tiers.informational: Reading, drafting, planning, thinking. Standard quality gates only.
